title: Coral and the Echo
author: August Okafor
blurb: Jonah Underhill, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
